verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.simular.ai that links to markdown versions of doc pages. A second llms.txt at www.simular.ai describes the product, its safety model and its marketplace in agent-readable form. Agent-oriented guidance also ships as installable skills (the Sai skill that teaches Claude Code the task loop, and the /simulang skill). Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.
